turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - cdft_piezo_d_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`,
    `poscar` (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format) and `d_ij` (the
    piezoelectric strain coefficient max|d_ij|, in pC/N).
  - cdft_piezo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose
    properties are NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar`
    (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the LARGEST
piezoelectric strain coefficient max|d_ij| (in pC/N), then select the 5 best
candidates from the pool.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training set shows that the largest piezoelectric responses (max \(|d_{ij}|\) \(\gtrsim 100\) pC/N) occur in two well-defined families:

- polar halide perovskites that contain a stereochemically active lone-pair cation (RbPbBr\(_3\) = 154 pC/N),
- sulvanite-type compounds built from isolated tetrahedral anions (Na\(_3\)SbS\(_4\) = 149 pC/N, TaTl\(_3\)S\(_4\) = 132 pC/N).

Four pool entries belong to exactly these families and adopt the same (or very closely related) crystal structures:

- c043 (K\(_3\)SbS\(_4\)) is isostructural with Na\(_3\)SbS\(_4\);
- c041 (KGeCl\(_3\)) and the two InGeCl\(_3\) polymorphs (c025, c026) are polar ABX\(_3\) perovskites with Ge(II) (lone pair) on the B site, directly analogous to RbPbBr\(_3\).

A fifth high-response candidate is c077 (Pb\(_2\)O\(_3\)). Lead-containing polar structures in the training set (PbS, PbTiO\(_3\)) consistently give \(|d_{ij}|\) in the 80–140 pC/N range; the same chemistry and the absence of inversion symmetry therefore place Pb\(_2\)O\(_3\) immediately after the four compounds listed above.

All other pool entries are either centrosymmetric analogues of low-response training compounds, ordinary wurtzite/zincblende phases (\(\sim\)20 pC/N), or chemically unrelated and therefore expected to lie well below the five structures identified here.

Final: c043, c041, c025, c026, c077
